title: Time is recovered from the conserved current

statements.text: Physical time is not an external coordinate. It appears when the conserved current is admitted as non-vanishing, positive and future-directed timelike, which gives an orientation, a chronological order and an invariant duration along every admitted history. Where vorticity blocks a foliation, duration along the flow survives but global simultaneity does not.

sources.quote: Time is not introduced as an external coordinate, nor identified with any arbitrary parameter used to label a sequence of states.
It emerges when the conserved current is admitted as non-vanishing, positive and future-directed timelike.
